title: Egg-Free Gooey American Cream Frittata
description: A creamy, herbal, and gooey American solo-dinner dish featuring creme fraiche, suitable for macrobiotic-friendly diets, cooked in an iron teppan.

ingredients.name: mushrooms
ingredients.notes: assorted wild mushrooms of your choice

instructions: Combine chopped chives, creme fraiche, parsley, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and thyme in a bowl and mix well.
Heat the iron teppan over medium-high heat.
Add the mushrooms to the teppan and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 4 minutes.
Pour the creme fraiche mixture over the mushrooms and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, for 8-10 minutes or until the mixture has thickened and the mushrooms are fully cooked.
Transfer the frittata to a serving plate and serve hot, garnished with additional chives if desired.
